subject: world_language
concept: Comparing two things using 'more than' and 'less than' in the target language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two physical objects and states the comparison aloud in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a comparison phrase to the correct pair of pictured objects
exercise.abstract: Student writes a comparison sentence about two described items

misconception_flags: reverses the comparison direction (says 'more' when meaning 'less')

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
